Test Scenario Description: Application health check - verify Mines Entry service is up
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Start the Mines Entry application.
2. Send GET request to /.
3. Verify response service name and status.
Remarks: Expected HTTP 200 with service=GMDC Mines Entry. Base smoke check before other UCs.

Test Scenario Description: View current application state and hardware snapshot
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Ensure application is running.
2. Send GET /api/status.
3. Verify state (e.g. IDLE) and hardware/transaction fields.
Remarks: Used by operators/support to confirm IDLE/busy and I/O status.

Test Scenario Description: Force reset application to IDLE safe state
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Put application in any non-IDLE state if needed.
2. Send POST /api/reset.
3. Verify state returns to IDLE.
4. Verify traffic light RED and boom CLOSED.
5. Verify RFID reader IDLE prepare (login/mode/start) if cloud enabled.
Remarks: Emergency / recovery use case. Clears transaction and sensor latch.

Test Scenario Description: Idle hardware initialize - TL red and boom closed on startup
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Set DEMO_MODE=false and correct Modbus IP.
2. Start application.
3. Observe DO coils and logs.
4. Confirm TrafficLight RED and BoomBarrier CLOSED.

Test Scenario Description: Connect to real Modbus I/O controller (FC2 DI / FC5 DO)
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Set DEMO_MODE=false in .env.
2. Confirm iot_configuration ethernet IP 192.168.31.89 port 502 slave 1.
3. Start application.
4. Verify log ModbusTCP connected read_fc=2 write_fc=5.
Remarks: Must NOT use DemoIOController when running on site hardware.

Test Scenario Description: Demo mode uses in-memory I/O instead of real controller
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Set DEMO_MODE=true.
2. Start application.
3. Verify DemoIOController connected in logs.
4. Confirm no Modbus TCP connection to controller.
Remarks: Useful for offline unit/integration testing only.

Test Scenario Description: RFID API mode - no TCP client to reader port
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Ensure rfids.entry_a.mode=API in iot_configuration.
2. Start application with DEMO_MODE=false.
3. Confirm no WinError 10061 RFID client retry logs.
4. Confirm RFID status type=api.
Remarks: Tags arrive via HTTP POST /rfid_data

Test Scenario Description: RFID cloud IDLE prepare - login then mode then start
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Application reaches IDLE.
2. Observe RFID cloud calls: localRestLogin (Basic) → mode (Bearer) → start (Bearer).
3. Confirm reader is scanning for next vehicle.
Remarks: Runs on bootstrap and after each reset to IDLE.

Test Scenario Description: Receive valid RFID tags from fixed reader via /rfid_data
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Ensure state is IDLE.
2. Reader (or tool) POSTs Zebra tag JSON to /rfid_data with idHex.
3. Verify HTTP 200 status=success and tags list.
4. Verify RFID cloud stop is called.
5. Verify OCI rfid-validate is invoked.
Remarks: Primary site path when Zebra FX pushes tags to self-hosted API.

Test Scenario Description: Reject /rfid_data when payload has no idHex tags
Test Scenario Steps:
1. POST /rfid_data with empty list [].
2. Verify HTTP 400.
3. Verify workflow does not start.
Remarks: Protects against empty/keepalive noise without tags.

Test Scenario Description: Ignore RFID tags when application is not IDLE
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Start a cycle so state is not IDLE (e.g. WAIT_CROSSING).
2. POST another valid /rfid_data payload.
3. Verify new cycle is not started.
4. Verify log Ignoring RFID tags while in state …
Remarks: Prevents overlapping vehicle transactions.

Test Scenario Description: RFID management keepalive from reader
Test Scenario Steps:
1. POST /rfid_management with any JSON body.
2. Verify HTTP 200 status=success.
Remarks: Reader keepalive

Test Scenario Description: Mobile app RFID fallback - valid tag returns OCI validate response
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Ensure state IDLE (fixed reader unavailable/damaged tag case).
2. Mobile app POSTs {"rfid_data":"<tag>"} to /rfid_data_from_mobile_app.
3. Verify HTTP 200.
4. Verify response body is exactly OCI rfid-validate JSON.
5. Verify background flow continues (ANPR etc.).
Remarks: Mobile replaces physical reader when RFID cannot be read at gate.

Test Scenario Description: Mobile RFID - missing rfid_data key
Test Scenario Steps:
1. POST /rfid_data_from_mobile_app with {}.
2. Verify HTTP 500.
3. Verify body status=500 rfid_data=null message Error: …
Remarks: Client validation failure

Test Scenario Description: Mobile RFID - blank rfid_data value
Test Scenario Steps:
1. POST {"rfid_data":"   "}.
2. Verify HTTP 500 and rfid_data=null.
3. Verify workflow not started.
Remarks: Blank/whitespace treated as invalid.

Test Scenario Description: OCI RFID validate success - display truck and proceed to ANPR
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Trigger RFID (reader or mobile) with a tag OCI accepts.
2. Verify OCI rfid-tag returns status 200 with truck_details.
3. Verify display shows vehicle number.
4. Verify ANPR /api/detect is called next.
Remarks: truck_details pipe string parsed for vehicle_no token_no device_ip.

Test Scenario Description: OCI RFID validate failure - RFID ERR 1 then auto IDLE
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Trigger RFID with invalid/unknown tag.
2. Verify OCI returns non-200 (e.g. status 500).
3. Verify display shows RFID ERR 1.
4. Wait RFID error display timeout (~10s).
5. Verify state returns IDLE; boom closed TL red.
Remarks: For mobile path HTTP to client is still 200 with OCI error body.

Test Scenario Description: ANPR match (anpr_status=1) - grant entry after boom-close OK
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Complete successful RFID validate.
2. ANPR /api/detect returns anpr_status=1.
3. Verify invalid-truck-number is posted.
4. Verify boom-close API called with close-type=auto.
5. If boom-close status=200: boom OPEN TL GREEN; display Entry Granted.
6. State WAIT_CROSSING.
Remarks: Happy-path automatic grant.

Test Scenario Description: ANPR match but boom-close fails - boom must not open
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Reach ANPR anpr_status=1 path.
2. boom-close returns status != 200.
3. Verify boom remains CLOSED.
4. Verify log Boom NOT opened.
Remarks: Safety gate: physical boom open only after OCI boom-close success.

Test Scenario Description: ANPR mismatch (anpr_status=0) - ANPR ERR 1 and manual status_check loop
Test Scenario Steps:
1. RFID valid.
2. ANPR returns anpr_status=0.
3. Verify invalid-truck posted.
4. Verify display ANPR ERR 1.
5. Verify periodic status_check polling starts.
Remarks: Operator/manual correction path via OCI status_check.

Test Scenario Description: Manual loop vehicleStatus=1 - grant entry
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Enter MANUAL_UPDATE after anpr_status=0.
2. status_check returns vehicleStatus=1.
3. Verify boom-close then boom open / TL green / Entry Granted.
4. Enter WAIT_CROSSING.
Remarks: Manual approval after mismatch.

Test Scenario Description: Manual loop vehicleStatus=2 - reject and reset IDLE
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Enter MANUAL_UPDATE.
2. status_check returns vehicleStatus=2.
3. Verify reset to IDLE; boom closed TL red.
Remarks: Manual reject / abort transaction.

Test Scenario Description: Manual loop vehicleStatus=0 - continue waiting
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Enter MANUAL_UPDATE.
2. status_check returns vehicleStatus=0 multiple times.
3. Verify application stays in manual loop and keeps polling.
Remarks: Pending operator action

Test Scenario Description: ANPR anpr_status=2 - ANPR Err-2 then wait and reset
Test Scenario Steps:
1. RFID valid.
2. ANPR returns anpr_status=2.
3. Verify display ANPR Err-2.
4. Wait configured ANPR Err-2 display seconds.
5. Verify IDLE; boom not opened.
Remarks: Hard ANPR reject path (no manual loop).

Test Scenario Description: ANPR API unreachable - retry 3 times then ANPR API ERR
Test Scenario Steps:
1. RFID valid.
2. Make ANPR host unreachable / throw connection error.
3. Verify up to 3 detect attempts with delay.
4. Verify display ANPR API ERR.
5. Verify reset IDLE; boom not opened.
Remarks: Transport failure handling
column6: does not call invalid-truck if ANPR never succeeds.

Test Scenario Description: ANPR recovers on retry - grant after transient failure
Test Scenario Steps:
1. RFID valid.
2. First ANPR call fails; second returns anpr_status=1.
3. Verify grant path proceeds normally.
Remarks: Transient network/API flake tolerance.

Test Scenario Description: Vehicle crossing - sensor FALSE→TRUE→FALSE closes gate
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Complete grant so boom OPEN TL GREEN (WAIT_CROSSING).
2. Confirm sensor idle FALSE.
3. Truck on sensor → TRUE (occupied).
4. Truck clears → FALSE (falling edge).
5. Verify boom CLOSED TL RED state IDLE.
6. Verify RFID IDLE prepare for next vehicle.
Remarks: Falling-after-occupied edge detection

Test Scenario Description: Sensor rising edge alone must not close boom
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Reach WAIT_CROSSING with boom open.
2. Drive sensor to TRUE and keep it TRUE.
3. Verify boom stays OPEN and state remains WAIT_CROSSING.
Remarks: Close only after clear (TRUE then FALSE).

Test Scenario Description: Sensor activity during IDLE/validation must not reset cycle
Test Scenario Steps:
1. While IDLE or during RFID/ANPR validation pulse sensor TRUE then FALSE.
2. Verify boom/TL not incorrectly changed by crossing clear.
3. Verify no premature IDLE reset of an active validation cycle.
Remarks: Crossing-clear ignored unless ENTRY_GRANTED/WAIT_CROSSING.

Test Scenario Description: Crossing timeout - auto IDLE if truck never clears sensor
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Grant entry (WAIT_CROSSING).
2. Do not complete sensor clear sequence.
3. Wait vehicle_crossing_timeout from iot_configuration.
4. Verify auto IDLE; boom closed TL red.
Remarks: Safety timeout if sensor miss or vehicle stalled.

Test Scenario Description: Simulate sensor clear via API (demo/helper)
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Reach WAIT_CROSSING (demo I/O or configured simulate).
2. POST /api/simulate-exit.
3. Verify pulse TRUE then FALSE and reset to IDLE hardware.
Remarks: Lab/demo helper when physical sensor not available.

Test Scenario Description: Display publishes RFID ERR 1 on validate failure
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Trigger invalid RFID.
2. Verify MQTT/display shows RFID ERR 1.
Remarks: Operator-visible error messaging.

Test Scenario Description: Display publishes truck number after RFID success
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Trigger valid RFID.
2. Verify display shows vehicle number from truck_details.
Remarks: Driver/operator feedback before ANPR.

Test Scenario Description: Display publishes Entry Granted after successful grant
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Complete ANPR match or manual approve with boom-close OK.
2. Verify display shows {truck} Entry Granted.
Remarks: Confirms gate open authorization to user.

Test Scenario Description: End-to-end happy path - reader RFID to IDLE after clear
Test Scenario Steps:
1. IDLE.
2. POST /rfid_data valid tag.
3. OCI RFID 200.
4. ANPR anpr_status=1.
5. boom-close 200 → boom open TL green.
6. Sensor TRUE then FALSE.
7. Verify IDLE ready for next truck.
Remarks: Full production reader path.

Test Scenario Description: End-to-end happy path - mobile RFID to IDLE after clear
Test Scenario Steps:
1. IDLE.
2. POST /rfid_data_from_mobile_app with valid rfid_data.
3. Client receives OCI validate JSON (HTTP 200).
4. ANPR 1 + boom-close 200.
5. Sensor TRUE then FALSE → IDLE.
Remarks: Full production mobile fallback path.

Test Scenario Description: End-to-end manual approve path after ANPR mismatch
Test Scenario Steps:
1. RFID valid.
2. ANPR anpr_status=0 → ANPR ERR 1.
3. status_check eventually vehicleStatus=1.
4. Grant hardware.
5. Sensor clear → IDLE.
Remarks: Covers mismatch + operator correction.

Test Scenario Description: Concurrent second RFID ignored while cycle busy
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Start first RFID cycle.
2. Immediately send second RFID (reader or mobile).
3. Verify second is rejected/ignored.
4. Verify first cycle completes without corruption.
Remarks: Single-transaction lock / state guard.

Test Scenario Description: OCI payloads include configured DEVICE_IP
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Set DEVICE_IP in .env.
2. Trigger RFID validate / boom-close / invalid-truck.
3. Verify device_ip in request bodies matches env.
Remarks: Site identity for OCI checkpoint APIs.

Test Scenario Description: ANPR calls separate host with its own Basic Auth
Test Scenario Steps:
1. Configure ANPR_BASE_URL and ANPR_USERNAME/PASSWORD.
2. Trigger ANPR detect.
3. Verify request goes to ANPR host /api/detect not OCI base.
4. Verify ANPR Basic Auth used.
Remarks: ANPR service is independent of OCI ORDS host.
